# VTube Studio script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## vtubestudio.getCurrentModel

Tells you which model VTube Studio has loaded and where it is on screen. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

**Gives back:** loaded (true/false), name, id, positionX, positionY, rotation and size.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.getCurrentModel");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_get_current_model()
    ```

## vtubestudio.getExpressions

Lists the face expressions of the model that is loaded now, and which ones are on. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

**Gives back:** A list of expressions. Each has name, file and active (true when it is on).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.getExpressions");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_get_expressions()
    ```

## vtubestudio.getHotkeys

Lists the hotkeys of the model that is loaded now. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

**Gives back:** A list of hotkeys. Each has id, name, type (what it does) and file.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.getHotkeys");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_get_hotkeys()
    ```

## vtubestudio.injectParameters

Sets tracking values on your model for a while, like tilting the head or opening the mouth. Your script waits until the time is over.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parameters` | `parameters` | The values as text, like "FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1". You can also give an object, like {"FaceAngleX": 20}. |
| `holdSeconds` | `hold_seconds` | Optional. How many seconds to keep the values, 0 to 3600. Default 1. |
| `mode` | `mode` | Optional. "add" adds the values to the tracking. Anything else (the default) replaces the tracking values. |
| `faceFound` | `face_found` | Optional. true tells VTube Studio to act as if it sees your face while the values are sent. Starts as false. |

**Gives back:** true when done.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.injectParameters", new { parameters = "FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1", holdSeconds = 3 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_inject_parameters(parameters="FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1", hold_seconds=3)
    ```

## vtubestudio.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to VTube Studio and allowed in as a plugin.

**Gives back:** true while connected and allowed, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_is_connected()
    ```

## vtubestudio.loadModel

Switches VTube Studio to another model. Fails with an error when no model has that name or VTube Studio is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `model` | The model's name as VTube Studio shows it, like "Akari", or its id. |

**Gives back:** The id of the model that was loaded.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.loadModel", new { model = "Akari" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_load_model(model="Akari")
    ```

## vtubestudio.moveModel

Moves, turns or resizes your model on screen. Values you leave out stay as they are. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | `time` | Optional. How long the move takes, 0 to 2 seconds. Default 0.5. |
| `relative` | `relative` | Optional. true moves the model by these amounts from where it is now. false (default) moves it to these exact values. |
| `positionX` | `position_x` | Optional. Left/right position: -1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge. |
| `positionY` | `position_y` | Optional. Up/down position: -1 is the bottom edge, 1 is the top edge. |
| `rotation` | `rotation` | Optional. How far to turn the model, in degrees, like 15. |
| `size` | `size` | Optional. The model's size, from -100 (small) to 100 (big). |

**Gives back:** true when done.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.moveModel", new { time = 1, positionX = 0.5, positionY = -0.2 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_move_model(time=1, position_x=0.5, position_y=-0.2)
    ```

## vtubestudio.request

Sends any VTube Studio API request and gives back its answer. For advanced users who know VTube Studio's request names.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messageType` | `message_type` | The request name, like "StatisticsRequest". Needed. |
| `data` | `data` | Optional. The request's settings as an object, like {"hotkeyID": "Wave"}. |

**Gives back:** VTube Studio's answer data, or null when it sent none.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.request", new { messageType = "StatisticsRequest" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_request(message_type="StatisticsRequest")
    ```

## vtubestudio.setExpression

Turns a face expression on your model on or off, like blush or angry eyes. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expression` | `expression` | The expression's name or file, like "Blush" or "Blush.exp3.json". |
| `state` | `state` | Optional. "On", "Off" or "Toggle" (switch). Default "On". |
| `fadeTime` | `fade_time` | Optional. How many seconds the change takes to fade in or out. Leave it out for 0.25 seconds. |

**Gives back:** The new state: true for on, false for off.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.setExpression", new { expression = "Blush", state = "On" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_set_expression(expression="Blush", state="On")
    ```

## vtubestudio.triggerHotkey

Runs one of your VTube Studio hotkeys, like a wave or an outfit change. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hotkey` | `hotkey` | The hotkey's name as VTube Studio shows it, like "Wave", or its id. |
| `itemInstanceId` | `item_instance_id` | Optional. The id of a Live2D item, to press that item's hotkey instead of the model's. Most people leave it out. |

**Gives back:** The id of the hotkey that ran.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("vtubestudio.triggerHotkey", new { hotkey = "Wave" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.vtubestudio_trigger_hotkey(hotkey="Wave")
    ```
